faqs.question: Why should I choose Magento over WooCommerce or Shopify?
faqs.answer: Magento (Adobe Commerce) is built for medium-to-enterprise businesses requiring high scalability, complex multi-store/multi-currency setups, advanced inventory management, and deep ERP integrations that standard platforms cannot match.

faqs.question: How do you handle Magento 2 migration without losing SEO rankings?
faqs.answer: We perform 1-to-1 301 URL redirects, maintain metadata structures, migrate all customer and order histories, and test extensively on staging servers to ensure zero loss in search engine rankings.

faqs.question: How can you improve the speed of our existing Magento store?
faqs.answer: We optimize Magento stores through Varnish caching, Redis session management, Elasticsearch integration, image compression, database query optimization, and CDN implementation.

faqs.question: Can you build custom Magento extensions for our business?
faqs.answer: Yes! We develop bespoke Magento 2 extensions tailored to your exact business rules, adhering strictly to Adobe Commerce coding standards and security practices.

faqs.question: Do you provide ongoing Magento security patching and upgrades?
faqs.answer: Yes, we monitor and apply all official Adobe security patches, conduct regular vulnerability scans, and ensure your store remains secure and fully PCI-DSS compliant.
